title: Spotify: Music and Podcasts
description:
With the Spotify music and podcast app, you can play millions of songs, albums and original podcasts for free. We have even added audiobooks, so you can enjoy thousands of stories wherever you are!

Stream music and podcasts, listen to audiobooks, discover albums, playlists or even single songs for free on your mobile or tablet. Subscribe to Spotify Premium to download and listen offline wherever you are.

Spotify gives you access to a world of free music, curated playlists, artists, and podcasts you love. Discover podcasts, new music, top songs or listen to your favorite artists and albums.

WHY SPOTIFY FOR MUSIC AND PODCASTS?
ΓÇó Listen to over 80 million songs and 4 million podcasts (and counting)
ΓÇó Enjoy over 300,000 newly added audiobook titles
ΓÇó Discover new music, albums, playlists and original podcasts.
ΓÇó Search for your favorite song or artist by typing a lyric
ΓÇó Enjoy amazing sound quality on music and podcasts across all devices.
ΓÇó Create and share your own music playlists to suit your mood or discover other playlists you might like.
ΓÇó Listen to daily music mixes made just for you.
ΓÇó Explore top songs from different genres, countries or decades.
ΓÇó Subscribe to your favourite podcasts so that you never miss an episode, then curate your very own podcast library.
ΓÇó Bookmark individual podcasts into Playlists
ΓÇó Listen to music and podcasts on your mobile, tablet, desktop, PlayStation, Chromecast, TV, Wear OS or wearable device.

Listen and discover the latest music from artists like;
ΓÇó Bad Bunny
ΓÇó Billie Eilish
ΓÇó Renzo Pianciola
ΓÇó The Temper Trap
ΓÇó Harry Styles

Listen to your favorite music artists all day every day via the Popular Radio playlist feature. Here are just some of the artists weΓÇÖve already curated;
ΓÇó Taylor Swift
ΓÇó Drake
ΓÇó Eminem
ΓÇó Coldplay
ΓÇó Paolo Nutini
ΓÇó Fleetwood Mac

Listen to over 40 category genres - New Releases, Charts, Live Events, Made for You, At Home, Only You, Summer, Pop, Workout, Hip-Hop, Mood, Party, Pride, Dance/Electronic, Alternative, Indie, Equal, Wellness, Rock, Frequency, R&B, Disney,, Throwback, Radar, Chill, Sleep, In the car, Kids & Family, Caribbean, Classical, Romance, Jazz, Instrumental, Afro, Christian and Gospel and Country.

Listen to popular and exclusive podcasts like;
ΓÇó The Joe Rogan Experience
ΓÇó Modern Wisdom
ΓÇó 2 Bears, 1 Cave with Tom Segura and Bert Kreischer
ΓÇó Call Her Daddy and Crime Junkie

Search, discover and play music, podcasts and audiobooks from all over the world for free, anywhere, anytime or create your own music playlists with the latest songs to suit your mood.

WHY GO PREMIUM?
ΓÇó Listen to albums and playlists without ad breaks.
ΓÇó Download and listen to music and podcasts offline, wherever you are.
ΓÇó Jump back in and listen to your top songs with on-demand playback.
ΓÇó Choose from 4 subscription options ΓÇô Individual, Duo, Family, Student. ThereΓÇÖs no commitment and you can cancel any time

Audiobooks in Premium currently available in Australia, the UK & the US. Discover 250,000+ titles, 15 hours/month of available listening for Premium Individual subscribers and Duo & Family plan managers.

Experience Spotify on your Wear OS device:
ΓÇó Enjoy your favourite music and podcasts without having your phone around.
ΓÇó Control playback on your phone or any of your Spotify compatible devices.
ΓÇó Download your favourite content for offline listening on the go (Premium only).
ΓÇó Get instant access to Spotify with our Tiles and Complications.

Please note: This app features NielsenΓÇÖs audience measurement software which will allow you to contribute to market research, such as NielsenΓÇÖs Audio Measurement. If you don't want to participate, you can opt-out within the app settings. To learn more about our digital audience measurement products and your choices in regard to them, please visit https://www.nielsen.com/digitalprivacy for more information.
